Please send:
1) First name  
2) Last name  
3) ZIP code
First name is Noah, last name Ito, and the zip code is 98187.
noah_ito_3850

Thanks, Noah Ito — I found your account (**user id: noah_ito_3850**).

- Address line 2 (if any)
- City

Send those and I’ll check the order status before making any changes.

For the watches, I want to change the silicone one to a metal one. If there are color options, I’d like white.
